annotations.title: Prepare a reship for a returned package

description: Prepare the current reship address for a returned order recorded with spellbook_returned_package_record. Pass the caseId and correctedDestination for an address_issue return; other reported reasons can reuse the saved original destination. A preparation is saved and remains current across reads. The returned row includes preparationId and the order-specific address. This legacy CSV preparation buys no postage and changes no shipment, stock or marketplace state. For a new reship, use spellbook_returned_package_reship_print and spellbook_returned_package_reship_dispatch. The older tracking-completion operation remains only for compatibility.

cases.description: Up to 50 cases to prepare. Required, at least one.

caseId.description: The caseId from spellbook_returned_package_record, or from returnCase in spellbook_returned_package_lookup. Required.

correctedDestination.description: The address to use for this reship export, from the marketplace order page. Required when the case's returnReason is address_issue. Omit it to use the stored address or TCGplayer packing slip. A supplied address applies only to this export and its new receipt; it never overwrites the shipment address.

addressLine2.description: The apartment, unit or suite line. Omit when there is none.

buyerName.description: The recipient's name as it goes on the label. Required.

country.description: The two-letter country code, such as US. Required.

postalCode.description: The ZIP or postal code. Required.

region.description: The state or region code, such as CA. Required.

expectedPreparationId.description: The current preparationId from spellbook_returned_package_work when changing a saved destination; send null for a first preparation. This rejects a stale edit.

context.description: Optional analytics context: describe the user's goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

idempotencyKey.description: A key you choose for this batch. Required. Send the same key and cases on a retry after a timeout to read the first result back.

workspaceId.description: The workspace that shipped the orders, from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required; writes only to this workspace.

name: spellbook_returned_package_reship_prepare
